title: Let us spy on the work
line: A daughter films her father at his desk: 14 years on one book, and he never turns round
proof: Sold: more than 100,000 books in about five weeks

title: Years in four seconds
line: Two makers show one trial of three years: glossy, frozen, shrivelled. Which one survived?
proof: Seen 23.2 million times, 178.1 times its usual

title: Will she answer?
line: Street interviewer asks a guarded woman a question, and a guard says: stop it
proof: Seen 52.2 million times, 14.3 times its usual

title: Start at the peak
line: Serial drama: a calm man orders ten Rolls-Royces to his house in ten minutes
proof: Its owner kept paying: top spend tier, 80 countries

title: The things before the face
line: Rails, a guitar, a far train, then the singer's face: an album sold on television
